scheme.title: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026
scheme.time_limits: Clause 10(1)(f): no reply from the regulated entity within 30 days (or longer NPCI/card-network timeline). Clause 10(1)(g): file within 90 days from expiry of that timeline or the date of the entity's last communication, whichever is later. No one-year rule in the 2026 scheme.

contacts.notes: Address, email, portal, 14448 and time limits quoted from the scheme text (clauses 6(2), 11(1), 11(2), 10(1)(f)-(g); Annex Part A paras 2, 6, 7). rbidocs.rbi.org.in serves a human-verification page to automated fetchers, so the scheme text was read from a regulated entity's verbatim copy; the RBI press release (prid=62052) confirms the PDF link and dates. RBI 'Complaints' page also lists crpc@rbi.org.in. cms.rbi.org.in itself blocks automated fetch.

contacts.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting (financial fraud helpline 1930)
contacts.operator: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
contacts.guidance: Call 1930, keep the acknowledgement number from the SMS, and submit full details on the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal within 24 hours.
contacts.notes: cybercrime.gov.in blocks automated fetching; portal URL corroborated by official bank pages (Airtel Payments Bank, Bank of India). 1930 replaced the earlier 155260.
